assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE polished landscape desktop fantasy RPG screen concept for the Allods Java ME reconstruction, approximately 16:9. Reference image is an existing local visual proposal: preserve its jade stone, gray masonry, restrained aged gold trim, brown leather buttons, Tagrim identity (mustached man, conical steel helmet, chain coif, red cloak), and hand-painted late-1990s Allods mood. More usable spacing, smaller edge ornaments, large legible Russian labels. Use the project-style compact bitmap-like Cyrillic lettering, green for interactive labels and warm pale gold for headers; no modern web cards, no sci-fi, no red HP bars, no paid training. HP green, MP blue. This is a static visual proposal; numbers are illustrative, do not invent mechanics. No monitor bezel or watermark. Create a revised CHARACTER TRAINING screen based on the reference composition, with five attributes left, known skills and a contextual detail panel center, full-body Tagrim at right. Header title "Персонаж", four party portrait selectors, selected name "Тагрим", "Уровень 5", an XP gauge "Опыт: 550 / 657" (illustrative). Two clearly separate counters: "Характеристики: 5" and "Навыки: 1". Exactly five attribute rows "Сложение" 30, "Интеллект" 10, "Сила" 35, "Ловкость" 20, "Удача" 15, each with minus and plus controls. Show a pending change on strength "35 → 36" and its remaining attribute counter "Характеристики: 4" instead of 5 if displaying a spent point, never both budgets conflated. Three known combat skills "Нападение", "Защита", "Тактика"; display "3 / 24", "2 / 24", "1 / 24" with plus buttons. A small readable caption "Предел навыка: 24". A short contextual hint "Минус отменяет только новые очки". A muted lock explanation "Новые школы здесь не изучаются" rather than extra trainable magic rows. Bottom buttons "Применить", "Отменить", "Назад"; draft preview changes only until Apply. Do not add respec, gold cost, extra equipment slots, skill tree branches, 25 as the displayed skill cap, or one shared point counter. Keep the soldier illustration grounded and unobscured. Readable Cyrillic, restrained number of labels. Training does not heal current HP or MP.

assets.edit_prompt: Edit the supplied inventory mockup. Change ONLY the item title in the upper-right detail panel from "Пластины из черепахи" to the exact Russian title "Полные латы". This correction is necessary because turtle armor belongs to Li, whereas Tagrim wears full plate armor. Preserve all other text, portraits, character, armor illustration, layout, dimensions, green/jade and gold styling, comparison numbers, two sockets and buttons unchanged. The existing selected scale-plate cuirass illustration can remain as a concept placeholder. Do not add requirements or any new labels.
